purpose: Phase-6B APOPTOSIS CONTEXT registry. Per (species, cell-model) apoptosis profiles binding Phase-6A cellular-stress states to a commitment gate + mitochondrial / caspase / AIF execution branches. Consumed READ-ONLY. B16, B16BL6, and B16-F10 are DISTINCT cell models and are NEVER silently merged: B16 carries the strongest experimental apoptosis context; B16BL6 (this project's canonical mouse melanoma) is an EXPLICIT CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION from B16; B16-F10 is a separate profile. HaCaT + rat are NOT_REPORTED. Population/tumour outcome is NEVER evaluated. STOPS at the apoptotic cell state.
branch_weight_note: caspase_weight + aif_weight reflect the reported PARTIAL pathway dependence. For B16: strong AIF contribution (AIF knockdown strongly attenuates), partial caspase dependence (caspase inhibition only partially attenuates) - so aif_weight > caspase_weight. No quantitative apoptosis %/fold-change is implied.

mouse_b16_apoptosis.uncertainty: Exact apoptosis %, Bax/Bcl-2 fold, membrane-potential mV, and caspase activity are NOT_REPORTED here (schematic only). The QUALITATIVE relationships (ROS up, pro-apoptotic Bax/Bcl-2 shift, cytochrome-c + AIF release, caspase activation, PARP cleavage, partial caspase dependence, strong AIF dependence, PI3K/AKT/mTOR suppression) are the experimental context for B16.
mouse_b16_apoptosis.stop_boundary: apoptotic cell state (single cell); no population/tumour outcome

mouse_b16bl6_apoptosis.uncertainty: This project's canonical mouse melanoma is B16BL6, but the strongest celastrol apoptosis mechanism evidence is in B16 (and PI3K/AKT/mTOR + ROS + membrane-potential in B16-F10). The B16BL6 apoptosis mechanism is a labelled CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION from B16, NOT experimental in B16BL6.

uncertain_differences: exact caspase vs AIF dependence in B16BL6
context_transfer.rationale: B16 and B16BL6 are closely related C57BL/6 melanoma lines sharing the celastrol pro-oxidant / survival-suppression mechanism; the apoptosis execution architecture is transferred with explicit uncertainty.

mouse_b16bl6_apoptosis.stop_boundary: apoptotic cell state (single cell); no population/tumour outcome

mouse_b16f10_apoptosis.uncertainty: B16-F10 supports PI3K/AKT/mTOR inhibition, ROS increase, reduced mitochondrial membrane potential, apoptosis, cell-cycle changes. Phase 6B implements ONLY the apoptosis-related portion; cell-cycle execution is deferred to Phase 6C. Exact quantitative values NOT_REPORTED (schematic). A PI3K-activator / survival-restoration intervention is supported here (evidence-permitting).
mouse_b16f10_apoptosis.stop_boundary: apoptotic cell state (single cell); no population/tumour outcome; no cell-cycle execution

human_hacat_apoptosis.reason: The accepted HaCaT profile is antioxidant / anti-inflammatory cytoprotection (Phases 5-6A), NOT apoptosis. No verified HaCaT celastrol apoptosis/cytotoxicity evidence relevant to the accepted context exists in the repository. Apoptosis is NOT_REPORTED; the cytoprotective HaCaT profile is never converted into apoptosis. A test-only predictive profile may exercise the architecture but stays disabled.

rat_skin_apoptosis.reason: Rat evidence concerns skin permeation, not intracellular apoptosis. Apoptosis is NOT_REPORTED. No mouse or human fallback.

context_rules.no_silent_cell_model_mixing: B16, B16BL6, and B16-F10 are distinct profiles; a relationship reported in one is never presented as experimental in another. Cross-model use is a CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION with source/target/rationale/limitations.
context_rules.canonical_runtime: The default mouse runtime uses B16BL6 (this project's canonical line) = CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION. Selecting B16 / B16-F10 via the engine's cell-model override runs that profile's exact labels on the shared mouse-melanoma upstream stress states.
context_rules.no_human_apoptosis_from_mouse: HaCaT apoptosis is never derived from mouse melanoma evidence.
context_rules.no_rat_apoptosis: Rat apoptosis is never inferred from skin-permeation evidence.
